headline: China Factory Activity Contracts in October as Export Orders Weaken
summary: China’s factory activity contracted in October as new export orders softened, reversing the previous month’s rebound.
why: China is the world's second-largest economy and a primary driver of global manufacturing and commodities demand.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Contraction in factory activity indicates weakening external and domestic manufacturing demand.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Weaker factory activity in China signals decelerating manufacturing demand, weighing on economic growth prospects.
